sources.primary_title: Popular AI planner Voiset launches version 2.0 and enters MENA at LEAP 2026 with full Arabic support
sources.verified_angle_summary: Voiset, an AI-powered personal planner, is officially entering the MENA market with the launch of Voiset 2.0 at LEAP 2026. The major update introduces full Arabic right-to-left (RTL) interface support and bilingual (Arabic and English) voice recognition, addressing a key demand from early regional users. Voiset 2.0 functions as a productivity assistant, allowing users to schedule tasks and manage calendars via voice or text, with natural language processing and automatic rescheduling. The platform also integrates with Claude and ChatGPT via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling advanced task management within AI assistant environments. The MENA launch targets professionals, entrepreneurs, and small business owners in the region, capitalizing on the growing demand for localized productivity solutions amid Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 expansion. This angle is distinct and highly specific to Voiset's product capabilities and regional strategy, supported by official press releases and company blog posts.
sources.verified_key_facts: Voiset 2.0 launches at LEAP 2026 (Aug 31-Sep 3) marking the company's official entry into the MENA market; The new version features a fully localized Arabic right-to-left (RTL) interface; Voice input now supports bilingual Arabic and English recognition simultaneously; Voiset 2.0 integrates with Claude and ChatGPT via the Model Context Protocol (MCP); The app is available on iOS, Android, and web with instant synchronization; The core product automatically builds and reschedules daily plans based on natural language voice or text inputs; Voiset targets entrepreneurs, small business owners, and professionals needing automated scheduling; The company highlights the MENA region's rapid growth under Saudi Vision 2030 as a key driver for localized productivity tools.
